name: grpc-deadline-propagation-p3
prompt: how do I make sure a gRPC request timeout flows through to every downstream service so nothing keeps working after the caller gave up

chunks.content: rebuilt the report layout with a responsive CSS grid
added a composite index on (tenant_id, created_at) to speed up the activity feed
the login throttler locks an account for 30 minutes after the request timeout on too many failed attempts is exceeded
outbound email is pushed onto a background queue and sent by a worker
records are soft-deleted with a deleted_at column and filtered from default queries
decided to thread the incoming deadline through the request context so each downstream gRPC call inherits the remaining time budget and cancels itself once the original caller's clock runs out
every fan-out RPC passes the propagated deadline rather than starting a fresh timeout, so a slow leaf service does not keep computing after the client has already abandoned the call
when the context deadline is exceeded the framework signals cancellation down the whole call chain, releasing the database connection and stopping work that would otherwise outlive the caller
cache the product catalog for 10 minutes and bust it on any write
the idle session timeout signs a user out after 20 minutes of no activity and clears their auth token
switch the list endpoint to keyset pagination using the last seen id
reload config on SIGHUP without dropping in-flight requests
record every admin action in an append-only audit log
enabled gzip compression on responses larger than 1 KB
gate the new checkout flow behind a feature flag defaulting to off
store all timestamps in UTC and convert in the UI
